contactSection.contactText: A little curiosity or the dream of a new best friend. Message Natascia: we reply to WhatsApp messages only.
contactSection.footerLine: English Cocker Spaniels. A family passion.

enquiry.dialogText: Prepare your message for Natascia. We reply to WhatsApp messages only, not calls.
enquiry.messagePlaceholder: Tell us a little about yourself…
enquiry.formNote: Nothing is sent automatically. Your details are not stored on this website.

privacyNotice.privacyText: This website uses no analytics or marketing cookies. The form prepares a message on your device without storing your details. If you continue to WhatsApp or email us, those services and Natascia handle the information to respond to you. For questions, use the email address shown on the website.
